GeoNames Postal Code datasets (DE.zip and AT.zip), retrieved 2026-11-02.
https://download.geonames.org/export/zip/
https://download.geonames.org/export/zip/readme.txt
Attribution: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Derived reference points only, not postal boundaries or company locations.
For each full postcode, average all listed place coordinates; for each two-digit
prefix, average these postcode reference points with equal weight. Coordinates
are rounded to five decimals. Dataset entries outside the DE/AT application
extent (lon 5-18, lat 46-56) are excluded. Missing prefixes are not invented.
These points are schematic orientation aids. GeoNames supplies data without
warranty of accuracy, completeness or currency. Regenerate using
scripts/build-postal-prefixes.py. Original customer data is never submitted.
